traditional: No classical doctrine: Neptune is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Feelings meet imagination and dissolution. A need for escape and reverie, high sensitivity, and compassion. Psychologically the square is inner tension to integrate: Emotional boundaries dissolve, leaving you drained by others or lost in daydream. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.waxing: Crisis of action: take conscious hold and build a durable form for feeling against imagination, or be thrown off course.
cyclic.waning: Crisis of meaning: break down the feeling/imagination form that has outlived its purpose and reorient toward the next cycle.

business: Friction in this area. Strong for imaginative work; protect boundaries and energy.
shadow: Moodiness and over-need collides with illusion and escapism; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: Friction builds toward a forced adjustment.
arcSeparating: The crisis passes; what was restructured settles.

readerCopy.body: When you are tired, disappointed, or bracing for bad news, an uneasy feeling can easily start masquerading as a hard fact. When the Moon squares Neptune, emotional ambiguity and sensitivity blur together, turning a delayed text, a vague response, or a strange shift in tone into definitive proof of whatever outcome you fear most. Your intuition might be picking up on real friction, but anxiety is dangerously skilled at filling blank space with worst-case scenarios. Take the emotional signal seriously without letting it write a final conclusion before the facts are actually in.
